recall.minute: Structural ambiguity: 'I saw the man with the telescope' (VP vs NP attachment); parses grow as Catalan numbers: 2, 5, 14, 132. A CFG (N, Σ, R, S) rewrites A → β; phrases NP, VP, PP are named after their heads. Top-down (architect) never builds illegal structures but guesses rules that don't match; bottom-up (builder) is data-driven but builds unusable pieces; both backtrack and repeat work. Chart parsers store constituents (key, chart, agenda, active arcs; NP → ART • ADJ N). PCFG: P(A → β) sums to 1 per A, estimated by counts; P(T) = Π P(r). Astronomers saw stars with ears: T1 (VP attach) = 1 × 0.1 × 0.3 × 0.7 × 0.18 × 0.18 = 0.0006804; T2 (NP attach) = 1 × 0.1 × 0.7 × 0.4 × 0.18 × 0.18 = 0.0009072 → T2. CNF: A → B C, A → a; fix terminals in mixed rules, unit productions, long rules. CKY: π[i, j, A] = max P(A → B C) π[i, k, B] π[k, j, C]; NP over 'the flight' = 0.3 × 0.4 × 0.02 = 0.0024; O(n³). Flaws: no lexicalisation (give vs sleep), no structural context (subject pronouns). PARSEVAL: LP, LR, F1; 100 guesses with 6 gold → precision 6%, recall 100%.
